name: system-overview
note: Three-layer architecture with module names only; the nine numbered flows, the colours and the failure mark on the source GPU are explained in the Figure 5 caption. Normal path 1-7: submit/dispatch, Slack snapshot, per-window block ranking, per-window Peer budget B from the watermark, placement plan (tier, L(Lr), block identities), Peer copy, DRAM copy. Failure path 8-9: detector -> recovery manager, parallel retries on p(g) reading the Peer Region zero-copy and the DRAM pool via preload + demand fetch. Offline tables (block size, K_l, C) feed the planner. Design semantics only; no algorithm is executed. Visual review of the native PNG/PDF is required after regeneration.
